Rashi on Yevamot 42a:10:1.hebrew: ויוציא את אמו לשוק - אם לא תלד אמו לשני וימות, וכסבורים שזה בנו, ותנשא אמו לשוק בלא חליצה:
Rashi on Yevamot 42a:10:1.english: And he will cause his mother to go out to the market - If his mother does not bear [a child] to the second [husband] and he dies, and they think that this [one] is his son, then his mother will marry [anyone in] the general public without chalitzah.

Rashi on Yevamot 42a:10:2.hebrew: ויפטור את יבמתו לשוק - אם יש לו אח מאביו הראשון, ולא היו לו בנים ומת, ואין שם אח אלא הוא, והוא סבור שהוא בן האחרון, ונמצאת אשת בנו של ראשון הזקוקה לו נשאת לשוק בלא חליצה. וגבי גר וגיורת, לחדא מהני הוא דאיכא למיחש, כגון לשמא ייבם אשת אחיו מאמו — שמא מעוברת היתה, וכשתלד סבורה היא שבן ז' הוא ובקדושה נזרע, ותחזור ותלד בן אחריו, וישא אשה וימות בלא בנים, וייבם זה את אשתו, דסבור שגם הוא נזרע בקדושה. וכיון שזה נזרע שלא בקדושה, וסתם עובדת כוכבים זונה היא, איכא למימר שמא אינו בנו של זה, ונמצא נושא אשת אחיו מאמו:
Rashi on Yevamot 42a:10:2.english: And he will exempt his yevama to the public - If he has a brother from his first father [i.e., his mother's first husband], and [that brother] had no children and died, and there is no [other] brother there except him, and he thinks that he is the son of the latter [husband] — thus the wife of the first [husband]'s son, who is bound to him [for levirate marriage], ends up marrying into the general public without chalitzah. And regarding a male convert and a female convert, it is [only] for one of these [concerns] that one must be concerned, namely, lest he perform levirate marriage with the wife of his maternal brother: perhaps she was [already] pregnant [before converting], and when she gives birth, she thinks that he is a seven-month [baby] and was conceived in sanctity [after conversion]; and she then goes on to bear another son after him, and [that son] marries a woman and dies without children, and this [first son] performs levirate marriage with his wife, because he thinks that he too was conceived in sanctity. And since this [first son] was not conceived in sanctity, and an ordinary idolatress is [presumed to be] promiscuous, one can say that perhaps he is not the son of this [convert husband], and thus he ends up marrying the wife of his maternal brother.

Rashi on Yevamot 42a:11:1.hebrew: בכולן אני קורא בהן - כל נשים שאסרו חכמים להנשא או להתייבם, קורא אני בהן תקנת ערוה, כדי שלא יבאו לידי ערוה:
Rashi on Yevamot 42a:11:1.english: In all of them I call them - [Regarding] all women whom the Sages forbade to marry or to enter into levirate marriage, I call them "ordinance [against] forbidden relations," so that they do not come to [a violation of] forbidden relations.

Rashi on Yevamot 42a:11:2.hebrew: וכאן - בהמתנה של ג' חדשים שאסרו חכמים לשאר נשים, אין כאן תקנת ערוה אלא תקנת הולד, להבחין בן מי הוא:
Rashi on Yevamot 42a:11:2.english: And here - regarding the waiting [period] of three months that the Sages prohibited for other women, there is no ordinance [to prevent] forbidden relations here, but rather an ordinance [for the benefit] of the offspring, to distinguish whose son he is.

Rashi on Yevamot 42a:11:3.hebrew: ואם איתא - דחשו חכמים לשמא ישא אחותו מן אביו, הא נמי תקנת ערוה היא:
Rashi on Yevamot 42a:11:3.english: And if it is so - that the Sages were concerned lest he marry his sister from his father, this too is an ordinance [to prevent] forbidden relations.

Rashi on Yevamot 42a:12:1.english: That [he] will not encounter - [i.e.,] the offspring [will not encounter] forbidden relations. However, [regarding] all the other women who are forbidden, there is an ordinance [for] her and the husband himself, so that they will not encounter forbidden relations.

Rashi on Yevamot 42a:14:1.hebrew: הא בר ז' לבתרא הוא - דאי מקמא איעברא כשמת, אישתכח דבר תמניא הוא, ובר תמניא לא חיי:
Rashi on Yevamot 42a:14:1.english: This is a seven-[month child] of the latter [husband] - For if she had conceived from the first [husband] when he died, it would turn out that it is an eight-[month child], and an eight-[month child] does not live.

Rashi on Yevamot 42a:14:2.hebrew: א"נ לתמניא ילדה כו' - תירוצא הוא:
Rashi on Yevamot 42a:14:2.english: Alternatively, [if] at eight [months] she gives birth, etc. - It is an answer.

Rashi on Yevamot 42a:15:1.hebrew: אישתהי - לאחר שנשאה. וה"ה נמי דמצי לתרוצי: אי נמי לשבעה ילדה, איכא למימר בר תשעה לקמא הוא — מעיקרא חדש אחד איעברא קודם מיתתו — אלא הואיל ותירץ למילתיה בחדא ואוקי דאכתי איכא ספק, סגי ליה בהכי:
Rashi on Yevamot 42a:15:1.english: She waited - After he [the second husband] married her. And similarly, [the Gemara] could also have answered: even if she gave birth after seven [months], one could say [the child] is a nine-month [child] of the first [husband] — [that] originally she conceived one month before his death — however, since it resolved its statement with one [case] and established that there is still a doubt, that suffices for it.

Rashi on Yevamot 42a:17:1.hebrew: אפילו למ"ד - במסכת נדה, בפרק בנות כותים:
Rashi on Yevamot 42a:17:1.english: Even according to the one who says - In Tractate Niddah, in the chapter [entitled] Benot Kutim.

Rashi on Yevamot 42a:18:1.hebrew: ויהי לתקופות הימים - הרי ששה חדשים וב' ימים:
Rashi on Yevamot 42a:18:1.english: And it came to pass, when the seasons of the days [had come] - Behold, [this is] six months and two days.

Rashi on Yevamot 42a:19:1.english: And let her wait a small amount [of time] - A week or two weeks.

Rashi on Yevamot 42a:19:2.hebrew: וכי מלו ג' חדשים - ליום מיתת בעלה, שדרך עובר להיות ניכר, ליבדקה בדדיה כדרך נשים. ואי מיעברא, ודאי בר קמא הוא, דאי בר בתרא הוא, אכתי לא הוה מינכר, דלא מלו שלשה חדשים לנישואיה, דחסר ליה ההוא משהו שהמתינה. ואי לא מינכר, ולבתר הכי מינכר, ודאי בר בתרא הוא:
Rashi on Yevamot 42a:19:2.english: And when three months are complete - from the day of her husband's death, when a fetus normally becomes recognizable, let them examine her breasts in the manner of women. And if she is pregnant, it is certainly the child of the first [husband], for if it were the child of the second [husband], it would not yet be recognizable, since three months have not been completed from her [second] marriage, as it is lacking that slight [amount of time] that she waited. And if it is not recognizable [then], and afterward it becomes recognizable, it is certainly the child of the second [husband].

Rashi on Yevamot 42a:20:1.hebrew: בהילוכה - מוליכין אותה בעפר תיחוח, אי מעוברת היא, פסיעותיה ניכרות ומעמיקות יותר משאר נשים, שהולד מכבידה. כך מצאתי בתשובת הגאונים:
Rashi on Yevamot 42a:20:1.english: Through the way she walks - They lead her over loose earth; if she is pregnant, her footprints are [more] noticeable and deeper than [those of] other women, because the fetus weighs her down. Thus I found in a responsum of the Geonim.

Rashi on Yevamot 42a:21:1.hebrew: מחפה עצמה - שלא תראה מעוברת, כדי שלא יבינו שבן הראשון הוא, ויירש בנכסי בעלה שני:
Rashi on Yevamot 42a:21:1.english: Masks herself - So that she will not appear pregnant, so that they will not realize that he is the son of the first [husband], and he will inherit the property of her second husband.

Rashi on Yevamot 42a:22:1.hebrew: היכא דקים לן כו' - הואיל וטעם המתנה משום ולד הוא, שלא יהא ספק, כשאנו יודעים ודאי שהיא מעוברת מראשון, תנשא. ומשני: גזרה שמא תעשה כו':
Rashi on Yevamot 42a:22:1.english: Where we are convinced, etc. - Since the reason for the waiting [period] is because of the offspring, so that there will not be uncertainty, when we know for certain that she is pregnant from the first [husband], let her marry. And [the Gemara] answers: [It is] a decree lest she make, etc.

Rashi on Yevamot 42a:23:1.hebrew: דידיה נמי - לא ישמש עם אשתו מעוברת, שמא תחזור ותתעבר, וידחוק אחיו וימעך צורת פניו כסנדל הזה שאין לו צורה:
Rashi on Yevamot 42a:23:1.english: His own [child] as well - He should not have marital relations with his pregnant wife, lest she conceive again, and [the new fetus] press against its sibling and flatten the shape of its face like this sandal [fish], which has no shape.

Rashi on Yevamot 42a:24:1.hebrew: אי למ"ד במוך במוך - פלוגתא היא בפ"ק (לעיל יבמות דף יב:):
Rashi on Yevamot 42a:24:1.english: If according to the one who says with a resorbent, [then] with a resorbent - It is a dispute in the first chapter (above, Yevamot 12b).

Rashi on Yevamot 42a:26:1.hebrew: דחסה - שממעכו בשעת תשמיש. דחסה לשון לחץ שלוחצו, כדאמר לקמן (יבמות דף קג.) גבי חליצה: צריך למידחסיה לכרעיה:
Rashi on Yevamot 42a:26:1.english: Pressure [dachsah] - That he crushes it [the fetus] at the time of intercourse. Dachsah is an expression of pressing, that he presses it, as it says later (Yevamot 103a) regarding chalitzah: he must press his foot down.

Rashi on Yevamot 42a:26:2.hebrew: ה"נ חייס עילויה - שאין אדם מתכוין להרוג הנפש:
Rashi on Yevamot 42a:26:2.english: Here, too, he has mercy upon it - For a person does not intend to kill a life:

Rashi on Yevamot 42a:27:1.english: [She] is poised to nurse - When she gives birth, she will nurse it.

Rashi on Yevamot 42a:2:1.hebrew: הוי - כלומר, הוי לומד מכאן, שלשה חדשים שאמרו כו':
Rashi on Yevamot 42a:2:1.english: Hevei [It must be] - That is to say, learn from here [that] "the three months that they stated," etc.

Rashi on Yevamot 42a:3:1.hebrew: ומ"ש מגט דרב אמר משעת נתינה - ואף על גב דמשעת כתיבה לא נתייחד עמה, דאם כן הוה ליה גט ישן, ואפילו הכי משעת נתינה מנינן, ה"נ נמני משעת חליצה:
Rashi on Yevamot 42a:3:1.english: And how is [this] different from a bill of divorce, where Rav said from the time of giving - Even though from the time of writing he was not secluded with her — for if so, it would be an old bill of divorce [which is invalid] — and even so we count [the three months] from the time of giving, here too we should count from the time of ḥalitza.

Rashi on Yevamot 42a:4:1.hebrew: לאיסור כרת - ליבם התרת לאחר ג' חדשים מיד:
Rashi on Yevamot 42a:4:1.english: [With regard] to a prohibition of karet - For the yavam, you permitted [it] immediately after three months.

Rashi on Yevamot 42a:4:2.hebrew: לאיסור לאו - לשוק, לא כ"ש דמותרת לאחר חליצה מיד, הואיל ועברו שלשה חדשים מיום מיתה:
Rashi on Yevamot 42a:4:2.english: For a negative prohibition - [Namely, marrying] an outsider, is it not all the more so [clear] that she is permitted immediately after chalitzah, since three months have passed from the day of [her husband's] death?

Rashi on Yevamot 42a:6:1.hebrew: ולזרעך אחריך - שאין השכינה שורה אלא על הוודאים, שזרעו מיוחס אחריו. והכי נמי קיימא לן בנדרים (דף כ:): "וברותי מכם המורדים והפושעים בי" — אלו בני ערבוביא:
Rashi on Yevamot 42a:6:1.english: And to your seed after you - For the Divine Presence rests only upon those of certain [lineage], whose seed is traced to him. And so too we hold in Nedarim (20b): “And I will purge from among you the rebels and those who transgress against Me” — these are children of intermingling [of lineage].

Rashi on Yevamot 42a:7:1.hebrew: גר וגיורת - גר שנתגייר ואשתו עמו, צריכים להמתין ג' חדשים לפרוש זה מזה. והכא מאי להבחין איכא? הרי אין כאן ראשון ושני:
Rashi on Yevamot 42a:7:1.english: A male convert and a female convert - A convert who converted with his wife — they must wait three months to separate from each other. And here, what [reason] to distinguish is there? Behold, there is no first [husband] and second [husband] here.

Rashi on Yevamot 42a:9:1.hebrew: רבא אמר שמא ישא אחותו מאביו - אם נשאת תוך שלשה וילדה, והוא בן ט' לראשון ונולד בביתו של שני, וסבור שהוא בנו, וישא את בת בעלה הראשון שיש לו מאשה אחרת, והיא אחותו מן האב:
Rashi on Yevamot 42a:9:1.english: Rava said: Lest he marry his paternal sister - If she married within three [months] and gave birth — and he is a nine-[month] child of the first [husband] and was born in the house of the second, and he thinks that he is his son — he might marry the daughter of her first husband whom [the first husband] has from another wife, and she is his paternal sister.

Rashi on Yevamot 42a:9:2.hebrew: ומייבם אשת אחיו מאמו - שאם תלד לאחרון בן אחר, וישא אשה וימות בלא בנים, וייבמנה זה כסבור שהוא אחיו מאביו, ונמצא מייבם אשת אחיו מאמו שלא מאביו וחייב כרת:
Rashi on Yevamot 42a:9:2.english: And performs levirate marriage with the wife of his maternal brother - For if she bears another son to the latter [husband], and [that son] marries a woman and dies without children, and this [first son] performs levirate marriage with her thinking that he is his paternal brother, it turns out that he is performing levirate marriage with the wife of his maternal brother who is not his paternal brother, and he is liable to karet.

Tosafot on Yevamot 42a:11:1.hebrew: בכולן אני קורא כו' - איבמה לחוד קאי, ונקט לשון כולן משום דאיירי בכל יבמות, בין ארוסות בין נשואות, בין להתייבם או להנשא לשוק אם חלצה תוך ג'; כולן צריכות להמתין שלשה חדשים:
Tosafot on Yevamot 42a:11:1.english: "In all of them I identify," etc. - [This] refers exclusively to a yevamah, and it uses the expression "all of them" because it is dealing with all yevamot, whether betrothed or married, whether to enter into levirate marriage or to marry someone from the general public if she performed chalitzah within three [months]; all of them must wait three months.

Tosafot on Yevamot 42a:19:1.hebrew: ותמתין משהו ותנשא - לאו דוקא משהו, שצריכה להמתין שלשה ימים של קליטת הזרע:
Tosafot on Yevamot 42a:19:1.english: And let her wait a minimal amount [of time] and marry - [This is] not literally a minimal amount [of time], for she must wait three days for the absorption of the semen.

Tosafot on Yevamot 42a:1:1.hebrew: לאחר שלשה חדשים אין צריכה להמתין - אמר ר"ת: דוקא חלץ, שהחליצה מוכחת שלא בא עליה, כדאמר בממאנת דמיאונה מוכיח עליה שהיא קטנה; אבל אם מת היבם לאחר ג', צריכה להמתין שלשה חדשים, דיותר יבמה קרובה לביאה מארוסה, דגזרינן אטו נשואה. אע"ג דאמר לקמן בפ' ב"ש (יבמות דף קיב.) ובפסחים פרק אלו דברים (פסחים דף עב:): "יבמתו בזיז מינה, אשתו לא בזיז מינה" — היינו לענין לאוקמי אנפשיה עד שלשים, אבל לענין גזרה שמא ישא אחותו כו', איכא למימר יבמתו קרובה לביאה טפי:
Tosafot on Yevamot 42a:1:1.english: "After three months she does not need to wait" - Rabbeinu Tam said: [This applies] specifically [where] he performed ḥalitzah, for the ḥalitzah proves that he did not have relations with her, just as [the Gemara] says regarding a girl who performs mi'un [refusal], that her refusal proves regarding her that she is a minor. However, if the yavam died after three [months], she must wait three months, for a yevamah is closer to [having] relations [with the yavam] than a betrothed woman [is with her fiancé], where we decree [a waiting period] on account of a married woman. Even though [the Gemara] says later in the chapter [entitled] Beit Shammai (Yevamot 112a) and in Pesachim, in the chapter [entitled] Eilu Devarim (Pesachim 72b): "Toward his yevamah he is bashful; toward his wife he is not bashful" — that is with respect to restraining himself up to thirty [days], but with respect to the decree lest one marry his sister, etc., one can say [that] his yevamah is even closer to [having] relations.

Tosafot on Yevamot 42a:27:1.hebrew: סתם מעוברת למניקה קיימא - רבינו שמשון, זקנו של רשב"א, היה אומר דגרושה מינקת מותרת לינשא, משום דלא משעבדא להניק, כדאמרי' בפ' אע"פ (כתובות נט: ושם): "נתגרשה — אינו כופה". ואין נראה לר"ת, דהא למאי דהוה בעי למימר דטעמא משום סנדל או משום דיחסא, לא היה חילוק בין אלמנה לגרושה, וה"ה להאי טעמא, דאינו חוזר בו אלא מהטעם בלבד. ועוד, אלמנה גופה, אי אמרה "איני ניזונית ואיני עושה", או תבעה כתובתה — לא משעבדא. וכן פוסק בשאלתות דרב אחאי, דלא שנא גרושה ולא שנא אלמנה:
Tosafot on Yevamot 42a:27:1.english: A typical pregnant woman is poised to nurse - Rabbeinu Shimshon, the grandfather of Rashba, used to say that a nursing divorcee is permitted to marry, because she is not obligated to nurse [her child], as we say in Chapter Af Al Pi (Ketubot 59b and elsewhere): "If she was divorced, he cannot compel her [to nurse]." However, this does not appear [correct] to Rabbeinu Tam, for according to what [the Gemara] initially wanted to say — that the reason [for the waiting period] is because of [the risk of] a sandal or because of lineage — there was no distinction between a widow and a divorcee, and the same applies to this reason [as well], for [the Gemara] only retracts the reason itself. Furthermore, even a widow herself, if she says, "I will not be supported [by the estate] and I will not work," or if she claims her ketubah, is not obligated [to nurse]. And so it is ruled in the She'iltot of Rav Achai, that there is no difference between a divorcee and a widow.

Tosafot on Yevamot 42a:3:1.hebrew: מאי שנא מגט דרב אמר משעת נתינה - אע"ג דודאי לא בא עליה מקמי כתיבה, דאם כן לא היה פוטרה בגט זה, דהוה ליה גט ישן; וטעמא מפרש בפרק שני דגיטין (דף יח. ושם): שלא יאמרו ב' נשים בחצר אחת זו אסורה וזו מותרת, שהעולם סוברים שכתיבת שניהם היתה סמוך לנתינה, ויבא להתיר תוך שלשה. והכא גבי חליצה נמי יסברו ששתיהן סמוך למיתה חלצו, ויבא להתיר תוך שלשה! ומשני: לאיסור כרת התרת — דאם היה רוצה לייבם אחר שלשה היה מייבם — לאיסור לאו לא כ"ש? דהיאך אפשר לאסרה להנשא לשוק אחר חליצה, שזה דומה לחוכא ואיטלולא ולא ישמעו לנו העולם על כך:
Tosafot on Yevamot 42a:3:1.english: "In what way is [this] different from a bill of divorce, where Rav said from the time of the giving" - Even though he certainly did not have relations with her prior [to giving it, from the time of] writing — for if so, he could not release her with this bill of divorce, as it would be an outdated bill of divorce [get yashan]; and the reason [for Rav's ruling] is explained in the second chapter of Gittin (18a and ad loc.): so that people will not say [of] two women in one courtyard, "This one is forbidden and this one is permitted," since people assume that the writing of both of them was close to the giving, and one will come to permit [a woman to remarry] within three [months]. And here regarding ḥalitza as well, they will assume that both of them performed ḥalitza close to the death, and one will come to permit [remarrying] within three [months]! And [the Gemara] answers: You have permitted a prohibition [punishable by] karet — for if he wanted to perform levirate marriage after three [months], he could perform levirate marriage — [so] is it not all the more so [that you should permit] a [mere] negative prohibition? For how could it be possible to forbid her from marrying [anyone] in the general public after ḥalitza, as this resembles mockery and ridicule, and people would not listen to us regarding this.

Tosafot on Yevamot 42a:6:1.hebrew: לזרעך אחריך - לקמן בפ' נושאין (יבמות דף ק:), דריש מהאי קרא דאזהר ליה רחמנא לאברהם: "לא תינסיב עובדת כוכבים ושפחה", דלא יתייחס זרעך בתרה:
Tosafot on Yevamot 42a:6:1.english: "To your seed after you" - Later, in the chapter [entitled] Nose'in (Yevamot 100b), [the Gemara] expounds from this verse that the Merciful One warned Abraham: "Do not marry an idolatress or a maidservant, so that your seed will not be traced after her."

Tosafot on Yevamot 42a:7:1.hebrew: גר וגיורת - מכאן משמע דגר מותר בגיורת, ודלא כאוסרים כשנשאה מקודם, דלא יחזרו לסורם:
Tosafot on Yevamot 42a:7:1.english: A male convert and a female convert - From here it is implied that a male convert is permitted [to marry] a female convert, unlike those who forbid [it] when he had married her previously, lest they return to their [former] ways.
